sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO IS_FORMULAR ( FORMULAR_NO, ITEM_NO, CONDITION, FORMULAR, CONDITION_SEQ, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CPNY_ID, ORDERNO ) VALUES( PA_INSURANCE_FORMULAR_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #ITEM_NO:NUMERIC#, #CONDITION:VARCHAR#, #FORMULAR:VARCHAR#, (SELECT NVL(MAX(CONDITION_SEQ), 0) + 1 AS CONDITION_SEQ FROM IS_FORMULAR WHERE ITEM_NO = #ITEM_NO:NUMERIC# AND CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID#), SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#, (SELECT MAX(NVL(ORDERNO,0))+1 FROM IS_FORMULAR) )
